text_block_list.text:
The "Summer Walk"—a chance to unwind and
recharge for the autumn season.
During this time, the Umamusume refresh
themselves by enjoying various events.

"All the girls on campus are buzzing with
excitement for the Summer Walk!
...Or so one would think—?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-What in the world is this~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I don't recall talking this much about
sweets...
Well, no, maybe I did mention them a
little bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, what's the deal? Hollering all
of a sudden.
You practicing for a choir competition? Or
did you just discover recited poetry?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"No, it is not! I am merely checking the
article from my recent interview.
However... this is a matter of grave
concern...!"
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—How I spend my days off, you ask?
I often host tea parties with my friends.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
How very elegant of you, as always~!
By the way, do you have any favorite black
teas?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, a black tea that pairs well
with milk tea...
Lately, I have taken a liking to Hallows'
vanilla blend.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Its rich, sweet aroma paired with a
robust astringency that holds its own
goes wonderfully with both baked and fresh
confections... It is truly exquisite."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm... Just listening to you makes it
sound delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so...! In particular, the
pairing with strawberry shortcake is
exquisite!
Truly the ultimate marriage of flavors...
Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahem! While I do not indulge in them
very frequently...
I do carefully curate the items served at
our tea parties, so...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, 'Furthermore, Mejiro McQueen-san is
also quite fond of
cream puffs from Fukiya, having once eaten
seven in a single sitting...'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: P-Please do not read that out loud!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, isn't this from when we went to that
all-you-can-eat buffet last month?
Man, that was seriously delicious, wasn't
it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, deeply... Wait, no, that's not what I
meant at all!
Now you're making it sound like I 'love
sweets'!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You totally love it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! B-But...
If you write it down just like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless! This is completely out of the
question.
You must cut out the part about the
sweets."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we'll cut from here to here...
and cut the Hachimitsu talk too.
In that case, the runtime might be running
a bit short~

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Could I add a story about Ryan-san
instead?
I'm sure the fans would love to hear about
that too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That poses no issue for me, either.
However, are you sure? Wouldn't that
require a massive overhaul...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it's our job, so please don't
worry about it.
We promise to deliver the absolute best
article—one you'll be completely satisfied
with!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I am truly grateful.
I apologize for causing you so much
trouble over my own selfishness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Was that really all right?
Even though that talk about sweets came
straight from my own mouth..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No! Even so, unacceptable is unacceptable!
I can't possibly let that be released to
the world as is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However... that was terribly selfish of
me, wasn't it...?
From now on, as a Mejiro, I must conduct
myself with far more restraint—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
――Found it, found it~!
The announcement for the "Splash
Recreation"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So it was posted here~ ...Wait, huh?
Hello!
Did you come to check the announcement
too, McQueen-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, I was simply passing by.
'Splash Rec'... was it? Are you taking
part in it, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm still deciding♪ This Summer
Walk event is wildly popular every year,
with tons of repeaters, or so I hear~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, the preliminary round is a
pool sports festival, and for the finals,
we'll go on a trip for a 'Water Gun
Battle'!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... 'This year's finals
venue is
the isolated Pacific island, "Makimi
Island"!' ...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, isn't this that resort famous for
being a hidden gem?
I've heard it's a quiet and beautiful
island.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that sounds wonderful♪ Even if we're
eliminated in the prelims, they say we can
go watch the finals,
so we'll be able to enjoy sightseeing on
the island to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This is a must-see. I'm getting so
excited!
It truly is 'the vacation begins before
you leave, and the field trip lasts till
you're home'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I-I see...?
I hope you have a wonderful Summer Walk."

"...Kukuku! Now, it's your turn. Come at
me...!
If your face-down card resolves here, you
turn this game around!"

Are you out of your mind? If you just sat
there and played 'wait,' you would've won.
Heh, sounds fun, challenge accepted! Don't
come crying to me if you regret it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That voice is...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ora ora oraaaaaah!! Take my "Howling"!
And activating skill: "Escape"! I'm gonna
tear right off this leash!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What the heck!? An "Escape" here of all
places?! And she's got
"Homing Instinct" to boot! Dammit, my
hands are tied! It's total defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good grief... As rowdy as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what, if you were watching you
should've said something~
Today's "Dog Game" was a legendary clash
for the history books!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh~ Looks like your love for
living on the edge finally backfired,
Nakayama!
Just as we agreed, you're joining the
'Splash Rec' too!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Tch, can't be helped. Playing nicely in
the water with everyone... not that I give
a damn,
but a bet's a bet. I'll join in."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, making a bet under such conditions...
So you're participating in 'Splash Rec' as
well, are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You bet! When you say ocean, you say ship!
And when you say ship, you say me!
Oh, and I already turned in Mac-chan's
entry form too☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon? What did you just say!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right! Looks like this year's gonna be
packed with tough rivals!
I'm gonna go train at a tatami shop for a
bit! I'll become a rush grass sommelier!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wha... You submitted my entry form without
asking!?
Hey! Hold on right theeeeere!
